problem_statement: LRUCache.get() does not mark the key as recently used, so a key that was just read is evicted first.
patch:
--- a/cachekit_lru/__init__.py
+++ b/cachekit_lru/__init__.py
@@ -9,7 +9,10 @@
         self._data = OrderedDict()
 
     def get(self, key, default=None):
-        return self._data.get(key, default)
+        if key not in self._data:
+            return default
+        self._data.move_to_end(key)
+        return self._data[key]
 
     def put(self, key, value):
         self._data[key] = value
test_patch:
--- a/tests/test_cachekit_lru.py
+++ b/tests/test_cachekit_lru.py
@@ -20,3 +20,13 @@
     cache.put("a", 1)
     cache.put("b", 2)
     assert len(cache) == 2
+
+
+def test_get_refreshes_recency():
+    cache = LRUCache(2)
+    cache.put("a", 1)
+    cache.put("b", 2)
+    cache.get("a")
+    cache.put("c", 3)
+    assert cache.get("a") == 1
+    assert cache.get("b") is None
